title: Icelandic Airlines 001
summary: Loftleiðir Flight 001 crashed on approach to Colombo on November 15, 1978. The crew was cleared to descend on runway 22 for an ILS approach. The approach controller warned the flight was undershooting but the crew was speaking with the radar controller on another frequency and did not receive the advisory. The aircraft descended dangerously towards the ground and crashed into a rubber and coconut plantation. The crash killed 183 out of 262 passengers and crew.
probable_cause: The official report determined the probable cause to be the failure of the crew to conform to approach procedures. During the approach, the crew did not properly monitor descent rate and position.

factors.evidence: The crew was speaking with the radar controller on another frequency and did not receive the warning that they were undershooting.
The aircraft was descending dangerously towards the ground and crashed into a rubber and coconut plantation.
Thunderstorms were in the area and wind shear was an issue.
The DC-8 crashed into a rubber and coconut plantation and exploded.

events.text: Control center informed crew would be landing on runway 04
The controller approved the request and gave instructions for an ILS landing on runway 22
Radar controller cleared flight to descend to altitude of 2000 ft and follow control's instructions
